nom: No7 Future Renew Damage Reversal Peptide Cleanser

segments.oily: One reviewer notes the formula is not greasy or oily and rinses off easily with water, with no reports of it feeling heavy on oilier skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as non-stripping and moisturizing, leaving skin soft rather than tight, though one notes moisture fades within an hour and skin feels dry again later in the day.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry-to-combination skin reports it leaves skin feeling moisturized with no tightness and no rush to apply serums after.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation and appreciate the fragrance-free, gentle formula, but one reviewer says it made her sensitive face extra red.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes using it on normal-to-dry skin, noting quick absorption, a soft radiant look, and reduced pore appearance.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s, 60s and those describing themselves as mature or anti-aging report soft, smoother skin and some perceived reduction in fine lines, though several caveat that it is too early to judge lasting anti-aging results.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers report a perceived reduction in fine lines, brighter tone, or smoother skin after two or more weeks of use; multiple others state it is too soon to know if it reverses damage or say results are subtle rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe the cleanser as hydrating and non-drying, leaving skin soft and never tight or stripped; one reviewer is an exception, reporting that moisture wears off within about an hour and skin feels dry again by later in the day.
concerns.redness: Reports are mixed: several with sensitive skin say it caused no redness or irritation, but one reviewer specifically states it made her sensitive face extra red.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping, leaving no tightness or dry patches even with regular use, including those who say other cleansers usually strip their skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with hyperpigmentation and sun damage reports increased brightness and hydration after a few days of use; no other spot-specific outcomes are mentioned.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports fewer breakouts with continued use, and another notes it did not cause new breakouts despite that being a common issue for her with other cleansers; no reviewer reports it causing breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Only one comment touches oil control, noting the product is not greasy or oily and rinses off cleanly with water.

aspects.libelle: Light fragrance detected despite fragrance-free claim
Good value at drugstore price point

extraits.texte: I don't really like this cleanser because it made my sensitive face extra red. Also it's not a foam cleanser more like a cream cleanser.

This is good for washing your face from nighttime lotions and serums or before you put them on your bare face. It isn't good for taking makeup off. It doesn't dry your face out maybe because it's cream plus it doesn't suds up but it has peptides and hoping it's good for my face. I have extremely sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate my face at all. In the past before this came out I bought several high end face washes to try and they all irritated my face but this does not. I like it better than other creamy cleansers I have tried and will stick with it. I am 66 with dry sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Very Nice Product As Well As Very Affordable
extraits.texte: I used the product daily, in the morning. I liked that it goes on smooth and my face feels soft afterwards. What I didn't like is the texture I would like something even more jail like it has a bit of a jail consistency, but I would like more of a pure jail completely translucent type of consistency. Also, I didn't like the fact that the moisture that is in the product, it doesn't last very long you might can get an hour or so of softness on skin, but as the day progress, I noticed that my skin was dryer again, so if they could add more moisture to the product, it would be perfect.

I am a 45 yr old woman, and have been dealing damage to my skin for quite some time, so when I received No7 Damage Reversal Peptide Cleanser, in exchange for my honest thoughts I was very excited!! I have extreme hyperpigmentation, sun damage, acne, and aging skin so finding quality skincare products is a must. The very first time I used this product i was blown away! Normally I prefer a cleanser that bubbles up, but this cleanser is a cream. I applied it to dry skin using circular motions. It was very rich in texture, fragrance free, and felt amazing. I rinsed with warm water and then patted dry. Ive used so many products that completely stripped the moisture from my face, but No7 was the complete opposite! My face felt, soft, hydrated, and was thoroughly cleansed. There were no traces of makeup left behind. Ive been using this product for a few days now and I can already see a difference in the brightness and hydration. I am so impressed by what I've seen so far, I've completely switched to this cleanser, and im going to look into purchasing the rest of the No7 damage reversal line. Im eager to see what longer term use will bring to my skin!!!

extraits.titre: i would buy this product again
extraits.texte: i use this product in the mirning and night With my other facial products. I really have seen a difference in my skin and it's been softer and less breakouts I definitely would recommend this product to anyone who is looking for a better skin. Also forgot to mention that I got this as a free sample and so glad that I did thank you so much.

extraits.titre: Tossing my Old in with this New!
extraits.texte: I have used this product for 2 weeks but, I was sold already on day 3. The application is straight to the point but that is where my first WOW came in. It's a lather that is like a lotion with silk onto your face. Then, the rinse. No burning in my eyes and rinsed off clean. My skin felt like I had already put moisturizer on and not just rinsed cleanser off. No tightness, no rush to get to serums either. I loved the way my dry to combination skin felt. I waited about 5 minutes before I finished the rest of my facial routine and I'm still happy! Definitely changing from my much more expensive brand to this!

This cleanser is extremely moisturizing. I have mature, normal to dry skin, and this cleanser left my skin feeling clean but not tight or stripped at all. I used it as the second step after removing my makeup, and am excited to keep using it. Highly recommend for those with dry or mature skin. I received this product in exchange for an honest review.
